caption: The drawing features a single wooden spoon rendered in naturalistic brown tones at the center of the composition, showing a three-quarters perspective that highlights the curvature of its handle and the depth of its bowl. The spoon has a smooth texture and a gentle, flowing curve along its length, ending in a slightly upturned tip at the handle. The drawing is placed within a large, lightly outlined square border. In the top left and bottom right corners, there are two smaller outlined square boxes: the upper left contains a side-profile line drawing of the spoon, while the lower right contains a top-down line drawing of the spoon. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Wooden Spoon
